# Pinned by `pip freeze` against a known-working install (Windows, Python 3.12, NVIDIA GPU).
# torch/torchaudio/torchvision carry a "+cu126" local version -- that build ONLY exists on
# PyTorch's own index, not PyPI, so install with:
#
#   python -m pip install -r vendor/requirements-whisper.txt --extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu126
#
# DO NOT `pip install faster-whisper` / `pip install whisperx` separately without this file --
# whisperx pulls in its own unpinned torch~=2.8.0 and silently overwrites a working CUDA build
# with a CPU-only one from plain PyPI if it resolves torch on its own. Confirmed on this machine:
# installing whisperx alone downgraded torch from 2.5.1+cu121 to 2.8.0+cpu with no warning.
# No GPU? Drop the --extra-index-url and let pip pull plain CPU wheels from PyPI instead --
# faster-whisper/whisperx still work, just slower than real-time on a full clip.
